triage.reason: This Government Resolution amends eligibility criteria, beneficiary age limit (from 60 to 65 years), ineligibility conditions, and required documentation for the Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana scheme.

changes.summary: Maximum age is raised from 60 to 65 completed years.

citation.quote_original: अ.क्र. (३) किमान वयाची २१ वर्षे पूर्ण व कमाल वयाची ६५ वर्ष पूर्ण होईपर्यंत.
citation.quote_english: Sr. No. (3) Minimum age 21 years completed and maximum age until 65 years are completed.

changes.summary: Unmarried women become eligible, but only one unmarried woman per family.

citation.quote_original: अ.क्र. (२) राज्यातील विवाहित, विधवा, घटस्फोटित, परित्यक्त्या आणि निराधार महिला तसेच त्या कुटूंबातील केवळ एक अविवाहित महिला.
citation.quote_english: Sr. No. (2) Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned and destitute women of the state, as well as only one unmarried woman from that family.

changes.summary: Only one unmarried woman per family can receive the benefit.

citation.quote_original: महिला तसेच त्या कुटूंबातील केवळ एक अविवाहित महिला.
citation.quote_english: women as well as only one unmarried woman from that family.

changes.summary: Contract staff (along with outsourced and volunteer workers) in a family are no longer disqualifying if income is up to Rs 2.50 lakh. Only regular/permanent employees and pensioners still disqualify.

citation.quote_original: तथापि, रु.२.५० लाखापर्यंत उत्पन्न असलेले बाह्य यंत्रणाद्वारे कार्यरत असलेले कर्मचारी, स्वयंसेवी कामगार आणि कंत्राटी कर्मचारी पात्र ठरतील.
citation.quote_english: However, outsourced employees, volunteer workers and contract employees with income up to Rs 2.50 lakh will be eligible.

changes.summary: Receiving Rs 1,500 or more per month from other government schemes now disqualifies; previously only more than Rs 1,500 did.

citation.quote_original: दरमहा रु.१,५००/- किंवा त्यापेक्षा जास्त रक्कमेचा लाभ घेत असेल.
citation.quote_english: is receiving a benefit of Rs 1,500 per month or more than that.

changes.summary: The disqualification for families jointly owning more than five acres of farm land is removed.

citation.quote_original: अ.क्र. (७) येथिल अपात्रतेची अट वगळण्यात येत आहे.
citation.quote_english: Sr. No. (7) The disqualification condition here is being deleted.

ambiguities.question: For contract, outsourced and volunteer workers, does the Rs 2.50 lakh income cap refer to the employee's own income or to the total family income?
readings: The cap applies to the family's total annual income, which is already enforced by the income condition, so these staff no longer disqualify at all.
The cap applies to the employee's own income, so a family could still be eligible under a separate test even if total family income is higher.

citation.quote_original: तथापि, रु.२.५० लाखापर्यंत उत्पन्न असलेले बाह्य यंत्रणाद्वारे कार्यरत असलेले कर्मचारी, स्वयंसेवी कामगार आणि कंत्राटी कर्मचारी पात्र ठरतील.
citation.quote_english: However, outsourced employees, volunteer workers and contract employees with income up to Rs 2.50 lakh will be eligible.

ambiguities.question: Does the exemption for yellow and orange ration card holders waive only the income certificate, or also the Rs 2.50 lakh income ceiling itself?
readings: Only the income certificate document is waived; the Rs 2.50 lakh ceiling still applies (no eligibility change, treated as a document change).
The income test is waived for yellow and orange ration card holders, so they are eligible regardless of income.

citation.quote_original: तथापि, पिवळे व केशरी रेशन कार्ड धारकांना उत्पन्नाच्या दाखला प्रमाणपत्रातून सूट देण्यात येत आहे.
citation.quote_english: However, yellow and orange ration card holders are being exempted from the income certificate.

skipped.topic: Alternative residence proof documents (15-year-old ration card, voter ID, school leaving certificate, birth certificate; husband's documents for women born outside the state)
skipped.reason: Required documents are not modelled in the rulebook.

skipped.topic: Income certificate exemption for yellow and orange ration card holders
skipped.reason: Best reading is a documents change, not a change to the income ceiling; see ambiguity.

skipped.topic: District-level committee reconstitution and new taluka-level committee
skipped.reason: Committees are procedural and not modelled.

skipped.topic: Application deadline of 31 August 2024 and benefit payable from 1 July 2024
skipped.reason: Application deadlines are procedural; the Rs 1,500 monthly benefit amount is unchanged.

skipped.topic: Incentive of Rs 50 per eligible beneficiary to Anganwadi workers for online applications

title_en: Amendments to the Chief Minister - Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana

verifier_cases.name: Age 64, just below new upper age limit of 65
verifier_cases.reasoning: Row 3 raises the maximum age from 60 to 65. A 64-year-old was ineligible under the old rule and is now inside the 21-65 range. She receives the full Rs 1,500.

citation.quote_original: हकमान वयाची 21 वषे पूणण व कमाल वयाची 65 वषण पूणण होईपयंत.
citation.quote_english: Minimum age of 21 years completed and until the maximum age of 65 years is completed.

verifier_cases.name: Age exactly 65, at new upper age limit
verifier_cases.reasoning: Row 1 states the age group as '21 to 65'. Following the glossary reading of 'until 65 years are completed', a woman aged 65 in completed years is inside the range. A strict reading could instead end eligibility on the 65th birthday, and this reading is flagged as needing confirmation.

citation.quote_original: 21 ते 65 या वषण वयोगटातील हववाहहत, हवधवा, घटस्फोहटत, पहरत्यक्तत्या आहण हनराधार महहला
citation.quote_english: Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned and destitute women in the age group of 21 to 65 years

verifier_cases.name: Age 66, just above new upper age limit
verifier_cases.reasoning: A woman aged 66 has completed 65 years, so she is outside the new 21-65 range set by row 3.

citation.quote_original: हकमान वयाची 21 वषे पूणण व कमाल वयाची 65 वषण पूणण होईपयंत.
citation.quote_english: Minimum age of 21 years completed and until the maximum age of 65 years is completed.

verifier_cases.name: Unmarried woman, no other unmarried beneficiary in family
verifier_cases.reasoning: Row 2 adds 'only one unmarried woman in that family' to the eligible women. She is the only unmarried woman in her family claiming the benefit, so she is eligible.

citation.quote_original: महहला तसेच त्या कु टूंबातील के वळ एक अहववाहहत महहला.
citation.quote_english: women, as well as only one unmarried woman in that family.

verifier_cases.name: Unmarried woman when another unmarried woman in family already benefits
verifier_cases.reasoning: Only one unmarried woman per family may benefit under row 2. Another unmarried woman in her family already receives the benefit, so this applicant is not eligible.

citation.quote_original: महहला तसेच त्या कु टूंबातील के वळ एक अहववाहहत महहला.
citation.quote_english: women, as well as only one unmarried woman in that family.

verifier_cases.name: Family member is a government contract employee, income within Rs 2.5 lakh
verifier_cases.reasoning: Row 4 removes contract employees from the disqualification. Contract employees with income up to Rs 2.50 lakh are now expressly eligible. Family income here is Rs 200,000.

citation.quote_original: तिाहप, रु.2.50 लाखापयंत उत्पन्न असलेले बाह्य यंत्रणाद्वारे कायणरत असलेले कमणचारी, स्वयंसेवी कामगार आहण कं त्राटी कमणचारी पात्र ठरतील.
citation.quote_english: However, employees working through outsourcing agencies, volunteer workers and contract employees with income up to Rs 2.50 lakh will be eligible.

verifier_cases.name: Family member is an outsourced government worker
verifier_cases.reasoning: Outsourced employees with income up to Rs 2.50 lakh are eligible under amended clause 5(3).

citation.quote_original: तिाहप, रु.2.50 लाखापयंत उत्पन्न असलेले बाह्य यंत्रणाद्वारे कायणरत असलेले कमणचारी, स्वयंसेवी कामगार आहण कं त्राटी कमणचारी पात्र ठरतील.
citation.quote_english: However, employees working through outsourcing agencies, volunteer workers and contract employees with income up to Rs 2.50 lakh will be eligible.

verifier_cases.name: Family member is a regular government employee
verifier_cases.reasoning: Amended clause 5(3) still disqualifies a family whose member is a regular or permanent government employee.

citation.quote_original: ज्यांच्या कु टुंबातील सदस्य हनयहमत/कायम कमणचारी म्हणून सरकारी हवभाग/उपक्रम/मंडळ/भारत सरकार ककवा राज्य सरकारच्या स्िाहनक संस्िेमध्ये कायणरत आहेत
citation.quote_english: Whose family members are working as regular/permanent employees in a government department/undertaking/board/Government of India or local body of the state government

verifier_cases.name: Family member is a government pensioner
verifier_cases.reasoning: Amended clause 5(3) still disqualifies a family whose member draws a pension after retirement.

citation.quote_original: राज्य सरकारच्या स्िाहनक संस्िेमध्ये कायणरत आहेत ककवा सेवाहनवृत्तीनंतर हनवृत्तीवेतन घेत आहेत.
citation.quote_english: are working in a local body of the state government or are drawing pension after retirement.

verifier_cases.name: Other scheme Rs 1,499 per month, just below new limit
verifier_cases.reasoning: Row 5 disqualifies women receiving Rs 1,500 or more per month from other schemes, and Rs 1,499 is below that. The unchanged top-up rule (old clause 2) pays the difference: 1500 - 1499 = Rs 1.

citation.quote_original: आर्थिक योजनेव्दारे दरमहा रु.1,500/- ककवा त्यापेक्षा जास्त रक्तकमेचा लाभ घेत असेल.
citation.quote_english: is receiving a benefit of Rs 1,500 or more per month through a financial scheme.

verifier_cases.name: Other scheme exactly Rs 1,500 per month, at new limit
verifier_cases.reasoning: The new wording 'Rs 1,500 or more' is inclusive, so receiving exactly Rs 1,500 now disqualifies. Under the old 'more than Rs 1,500' wording she would not have been disqualified.

citation.quote_original: आर्थिक योजनेव्दारे दरमहा रु.1,500/- ककवा त्यापेक्षा जास्त रक्तकमेचा लाभ घेत असेल.
citation.quote_english: is receiving a benefit of Rs 1,500 or more per month through a financial scheme.

verifier_cases.name: Other scheme Rs 1,501 per month, just above limit
verifier_cases.reasoning: Rs 1,501 is more than Rs 1,500, so she is disqualified under amended clause 5(4).

citation.quote_original: आर्थिक योजनेव्दारे दरमहा रु.1,500/- ककवा त्यापेक्षा जास्त रक्तकमेचा लाभ घेत असेल.
citation.quote_english: is receiving a benefit of Rs 1,500 or more per month through a financial scheme.

verifier_cases.name: Family owns 10 acres of farm land, condition removed
verifier_cases.reasoning: Row 6 deletes the farm-land disqualification (more than 5 acres). Owning 10 acres no longer affects eligibility.

citation.quote_original: अ.क्र. (७) येहिल अपात्रतेची अट वगळण्यात येत आहे.
citation.quote_english: The disqualification condition at serial no. (7) is being deleted.

verifier_cases.name: Typical case: yellow ration card holder within income limit
verifier_cases.reasoning: Yellow and orange ration card holders are exempted only from producing the income certificate. The income ceiling itself is still mandatory, and this widow's family income of Rs 150,000 is within it. She meets all other conditions and receives Rs 1,500 per month.

citation.quote_original: वार्थषक उत्पन्न रु.2.50 लाखापयंत असणे अहनवायण आहे. तिाहप, हपवळे व के शरी रेशन काडण धारकांना उत्पन्नाच्या दाखला प्रमाणपत्रातून सूट देण्यात येत आहे.
citation.quote_english: Annual income up to Rs 2.50 lakh is mandatory. However, yellow and orange ration card holders are exempted from the income certificate.

verifier_cases.name: Typical married woman, full benefit
verifier_cases.reasoning: She meets every condition and receives no other scheme benefit. Section D confirms Rs 1,500 per month.

citation.quote_original: हद.०१ जुलै, २०२४ पासून दरमहा रु.१,५००/- आर्थिक लाभ देण्यात येणार आहे.
citation.quote_english: A financial benefit of Rs 1,500 per month will be given from 1 July 2024.

verifier_cases.name: Before document: age 62 under old 60 limit
verifier_cases.reasoning: On 2024-07-02, before this GR dated 2024-07-03, the old maximum age of 60 applied. A 62-year-old is therefore ineligible on that date.

citation.quote_original: हकमान वयाची 21 वषे पूणण व कमाल वयाची 60 वषण पूणण होईपयंत.
citation.quote_english: Minimum age of 21 years completed and until the maximum age of 60 years is completed.
